race.description: Northwest Equestrian Expo Cup Day Showcase Sprint Hcp
race.comment: CROOK (8) has been racing in great heart and deserves a win. Settled just off midfield then drove hard late but just missed last start over 1200m at Coonamble. Four runs at 1100m have yielded two wins and two placings. Honest mare who is perfectly placed to score. DIS IS HEAVEN (5) found 900m a bit slick at Newcastle last time when second-up from a spell out but did rally late to finish third in the small field. Generally hits form at this stage of the prep and today's race looks a far better fit. FETES DES MERES (9) returned to form recently when a close second over 1400m at Dubbo. Likely to go back but the helter skelter pace will suit - one to watch for in the dying stages. MISTER BIANCO (1) brings the superior form to the table but 63kgs after the claim is a decent steadier. Each-way. ALL IN THE MIND (2) has not appeared since March 2025. Smart when right so keep an eye on the betting.
